selection: Same four English texts. Prefer the complete Linux CPU run; otherwise use the complete Linux CUDA run. Never combine devices within one model point. Default-voice mode only.
note: Four sentences per configuration. Published peer scores plus our earlier browser result; runtimes and scoring revisions differ.
method: The same four English prompts are used for every point. CPU results are used when complete; otherwise the complete CUDA run is shown. No partial runs are combined.
Peer scores come from tts-bench, not models rerun here. SmollerTTS is our earlier browser measurement. This overview uses a different test set from the 48-sentence comparison.
Published WER is the mean of four prompt scores from the source recognizer, not the corpus WER in our 48-sentence test. The two sets of WER results should not be compared.
Sizes are reported by each source; ~ means approximate. Components and counting conventions differ. Missing sizes or incomplete results are excluded.
UTMOS predicts quality, not human preference. Four prompts are too few for a reliable ranking. The line only marks the best observed score up to each size.
